description: Mirrors the employee access token as actually issued: Identity recomputes effective grants from IAM assignments and syncs them onto the Keycloak user attribute permission_grants, and a realm protocol mapper copies that attribute into the token as a list of PERMISSION#SCOPE_TYPE or PERMISSION#SCOPE_TYPE#SCOPE_ID strings (scope id omitted for GLOBAL). There is deliberately no principal_type, principal_status or authz_version claim: account type is resolved via GET /api/v1/users/me against user_id, and assignment validity is applied by Identity at sync time. Issuer, audience, signature, token size and expiry require runtime checks.
title: Staff access token v1 payload (Identity sync format)
